content:
sam: I pulled the quota templates. There's an edge case in the migration job that maps legacy numeric value -> (value, unit). Looks like for some tenants the unit wasn't set, defaulting incorrectly to 'second' instead of 'minute'. This makes a 60/min quota become 60/sec which is 60x stricter.

ryan: Ugh. That would definitely cause 429 storms and autoscaler thrash if we fall back to tight limits. Any easy mitigation?

maya: Short term: I can push a hotfix to the quota service to normalize units for existing tenants (treat unspecified as minute) and also add a guard in the rate limiter to ignore obviously incorrect conversions (e.g., allow > 1000/sec treated as per-minute).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started deploy of quota-service hotfix to staging (job: deploy-4221).

support-jen: Customers are on prod though. Can we apply a config override to the dedicated pool to relax per-tenant enforcement while fix rolls out? Maybe temporarily use pool-level soft-limits instead of per-tenant hard caps?

sam: Yes. We have a temporary knob: `rate_limiter.enforcement_mode = soft` at pool level. I can flip it for redwood-east-01 but want an approval and to note the risk of noisy neighbors.

ryan: Approving temporary soft mode for 30 minutes while hotfix lands and we validate. sam please annotate the change and set an automated revert.

sam: Done. Flipped to soft-mode at 08:12 UTC, revert scheduled +30m. Logging now shows:```
2026-02-28T08:12:08Z INFO rate_limiter: enforcement=soft pool=redwood-east-01 note=temporary-relax
```

support-jen: After the flip, one customer confirmed reduced 429s and latency drop. :thumbsup:

maya: Hotfix build passed staging tests. ops-bot: can we promote?

ops-bot: deploy-bot: promoting deploy-4221 to prod (canary).

sam: Canary looks good, no regressions in the quota-loader. Rolling to 50% of quota-service nodes now.

ryan: Good. Once hotfix is fully rolled, restore enforcement_mode to strict and validate counters. Also create a follow-up to add migration verification and an alert for unit mismatches.

support-jen: Noted — I'll update customer threads and create incident ticket.

maya: Root cause summary for the incident: migration bug left some tenants with missing unit field; downstream quota-loader defaulted to 'second' for unspecified units, turning X/min into X/sec. That produced artificially low per-tenant limits and surface-level throttling on dedicated pools. Action items: 1) Add unit validation in migration + loader, 2) Add dashboard for per-tenant unit anomalies, 3) Add safe-guard in rate-limiter to detect improbable units, 4) Postmortem + customer communication.

ryan: Assigning postmortem to maya + sam. I'll own communications with affected accounts. Closing loop once postmortem is posted.

support-jen: Thanks team. Incident resolved for now.

sam: Reverted pool enforcement to strict at 08:43 UTC after hotfix fully rolled. Monitoring shows 429s back to baseline.

ops-bot: alert: incident-resolved tag added.

support-jen: Will open a support follow-up for the customers with credits.
